text:
abe: Weekend dilemma: sunrise 6k run + sourdough bake (starter needs feeding) or full-on movie marathon (snacks + blankets)? vote now :running_man: :bread: :popcorn:

nina: Sourdough. ian't say no to fresh loaf on sunday AM. will bring butter. :bread:

rohan: Movie marathon for me. been hoarding a backlog. also my legs appreciate the rest. :popcorn:

sasha: Can we compromise? run Saturday morning, movie Sunday night. saves everyone. :shrug:

marta: @abe if you pick sourdough baking please share the recipe. instant envy guaranteed. :eyes:

abe: OK recipe teaser (super low-effort):
```
- feed starter Friday night 1:1:1
- autolyse 30m
- 3 folds over 2 hours
- bulk rise until ~50% (overnight fridge ok)
- bake 450F with steam 20m + 20m no-steam
```

rohan: GIF: https://giphy.com/fresh-bread.gif :drooling:

nina: Ian host the bake in my kitchen if folks want to come by 9am. limited oven space tho.

sasha: Ian bring a folding futon and projector for the movie night. also snacks: spicy chips + dark chocolate. :chocolate_bar:

marta: Vote tally so far: sourdough 2, movie 1, compromise 1. seems like a weekend of carbs is winning. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

calendar-bot: Tentative events created: "Sourdough Bake @ Nina" Sat 9:00 AM; "Movie Marathon @ Sasha" Sun 7:00 PM  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/24680

abe: Love it. If anyone wants to learn folding technique i'll demo. low-key class. :nerd_face:

rohan: RSVP'd for movie. will bring a duvet and extra pillows.

nina: pls bring butter. salted. :butter:

sasha: If it rains we'll move movie to the lounge. otherwise rooftop intermission? :thinking_face:

abe: Rooftop intermission sounds dreamy. See y'all this weekend :sun_with_face:
